newsitem.title: USA: Interstate Hotels offering priced at $25.
newsitem.headline: Interstate Hotels offering priced at $25.

text.p: Interstate Hotels Co said on Tuesday its offering of four million shares of common stock was priced at $25 per share.
All of the shares are being offered by the company, it said. Of the four million, 3.4 million shares are being offered in the United States by a syndicate led by Merrill Lynch & Co.

Some 600,000 shares are being offered in other countries, the company said. The underwriters have an over-allotment option of up to an additional 510,000 shares in the United States and 90,000 shares internationally.
The company said it intends to use the net proceeds to finance acquisitions, repay debt and for general corporate purposes.
